graph_policy: line-line shared raw node only; line-area and area-area actual source contact, never distance snapping; source contacts are 2D candidates, not physical paths
node_constraint_policy: access/conditional/indoor/barrier transport nodes require review; gate node does not create wall or building opening
surface_policy: retain source area holes; estimated centreline buffers are review geometry only; no buffer for denied or unresolved placement
width_policy: source width if valid single metre value; otherwise explicit estimate from lanes or highway; never infer sidewalk or vehicle lanes geometry from buffer
permission_policy: foot overrides access; motorcar overrides motor_vehicle/vehicle/access; conditional or unknown values held; all runtime permissions null
